requirements.message: A local Indonesian consignee is mandatory for Indonesia imports.
requirements.action: Reject the SI and request a local Indonesian consignee before submission.

requirements.message: The consignee Tax ID / NPWP is mandatory.
requirements.action: Add the consignee Tax ID / NPWP to the Shipping Instruction.

requirements.message: A local Indonesian shipper is required for Indonesia exports.
requirements.action: Add a local Indonesian shipper or confirm an applicable exception.

requirements.message: The local shipper Tax ID is required.
requirements.action: Add the shipper Tax ID to the Shipping Instruction.
